title: Mangalam Cement reports profit decline in second-quarter of 2027 financial year
summary: Mangalam Cement reports profit decline in second-quarter of 2027 financial year
body_markdown: **India:** Mangalam Cement's net profit for the quarter which ended 30 September 2026 was reported as US$782,792, down by 63.2% year-on-year from US$2.1m recorded in the corresponding period of 2025. Net revenue for the July-September quarter of 2026 was recorded as US$45.8m, up by 9.7% year-on-year from the US$41.8m recorded in the same period of 2025. Operating expenses increased by 11.5% year-on-year to US$41.5m from US$37.2m in the corresponding period of 2025.
